title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. translated_title: 从奖励模型“说什么”到奖励模型“如何思考”：用于大语言模型强化学习的注意力过程奖励模型
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLM）的重要组成部分。然而，现有的强化学习方法只关注最终输出或文本化的解题轨迹，导致奖励粗粒度且推理不可靠。这类范式主要关注模型输出了什么，而忽视了模型内部是如何推理的。因此，我们能否奖励模型内部的思考方式，而不仅仅是它说了什么？我们首先揭示了现有奖励建模方法中存在的文本奖励混叠问题。受此启发，我们提出了注意力过程奖励模型（APRM），它基于隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，以捕捉高质量的推理模式。APRM 仅拥有约 4600 万参数，通过排序目标和反事实目标进行训练，其奖励用于引导强化学习优化，并定期更新以应对分布偏移。该模型与表示……集成（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出注意力过程奖励模型（APRM），通过基于隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，从“奖励模型说什么”转向“奖励模型如何思考”，解决了文本奖励混叠问题，并以仅约 4600 万参数的轻量模型捕捉高质量推理模式、指导强化学习优化并定期更新以应对分布偏移。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), a lightweight ~46M-parameter model that shifts from rewarding what models say to how they think by assigning internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps, addressing textual reward aliasing while guiding RL optimization with periodic updates to handle distribution shifts.
